nodes.title: Note: MiniMax H3
widgets_values:
## MiniMax H3

[MiniMax H3](https://www.minimax.io/blog/minimax-h3) is MiniMax's general-purpose, omni-modal generation model. It jointly understands text, image, video, and audio, and generates video with **native stereo audio**: voice, sound effects, and music are modeled jointly in a single forward pass, not layered on afterward. Output is up to 2K resolution, 24fps, and up to about 15 seconds.

## ComfyUI links
- [ComfyUI#15224](https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI/pull/15224)
- [🤗 Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3)

## About this workflow

This template runs the **reference-to-video (ref2va)** task using the `MiniMaxH3ReferenceToVideo` node. It takes any mix of reference images, videos, and standalone audio, and weaves them into the generation to lock in a character's identity, a style, a motion, a camera move, or a voice.

**Key inputs**

- **ref_images / ref_videos / ref_video_audios / ref_audios**: up to 9 reference images, 3 reference videos (each may carry its own paired soundtrack), and 3 standalone reference audio clips
- **prompt**: reference the inputs by tag, in the exact order they were connected, for example `<Picture 1>`, `<Video 1>`, `<Audio 1>`, then describe the target scene, motion, and audio
- **ref_image_size**: `match` scales references down to the generation's resolution (faster); `max` keeps up to a 2048px short edge for stronger identity fidelity, at the cost of speed since reference tokens ride along every sampling step
- **width / height**: set via Resolution Selector.
- **duration (seconds)**: converted to a valid frame `length` by the Math Expression node

**Sampling and decode**

- Sampler: `res_multistep`. `beta` or `normal` scheduler tends to outperform `simple` for reference-heavy prompts like this one
- The sampler's joint audio+video `LATENT` output feeds directly into both `VAEDecode` (video, `minimax_h3_video_vae_fp16`) and `VAEDecodeAudio` (audio, `minimax_h3_audio_vae_fp32`); each decode node automatically pulls its own half out of the packed latent. `CreateVideo` then muxes the two into a single MP4 with synced sound
- The diffusion model here is `minimax_h3_ref2va_pruned_int8_convrot.safetensors`, a different set of weights from the `fl2va` model used by the t2v/i2v templates

Ref2va's output is very sensitive to prompt wording; matching the reference tags precisely and being explicit about which reference drives which part of the shot tends to work best.

summary:
[reference generation] A courier rides at speed down a rain-flooded neon street with a sealed case locked to his forearm, and feels nothing.

detailed_description:
Grimy cyberpunk street film, anamorphic, photoreal, night, hard rain, sodium-amber and magenta grade.

[Shot 1] Kesh rides a low courier bike down the flooded canyon, already at full speed as the video opens, throwing a wake of water behind him. The camera Tracks alongside him with large amplitude at fast speed, handheld and drifting, moving for the whole shot and never holding still. Rain falls hard through every frame and advertising holograms hang above the street.

[Shot 2] At 00:04.000, cut to a tight detail of his right forearm on the handlebar: the machined courier gauntlet with a sealed delivery case locked into it, rain beading and running off the metal, a small amber status ring pulsing on the lid. The camera Pushes in with small amplitude at slow speed. A bright cheerful automated female voice says in an off-screen voiceover: "Delivery in progress. Do not open. Do not feel." Kesh's lips stay closed through this and for the whole video and he does not speak at any point.

[Shot 3] At 00:07.000, cut to a close-up of Kesh's face, rain running over his skin, the matte prosthetic eye catching no highlight, neon sliding across him as he rides. The camera Arcs around him with small amplitude at slow speed, moving continuously. His expression does not change in a single frame while the street behind him flares and moves.

overall_soundscape:
Hard rain on metal and standing water for the entire video, tyre hiss through the flood, and the electric whine of the bike rising and falling with speed. Distant traffic and the hum of signage sit far back with no voices in them. Kesh breathes steadily through his nose, no words in it, and in the last seconds the case cuff knocks once against the handlebar.

non_diegetic_music:
A low synth pulse under a single sustained bass note, with a dry ticking percussion figure entering halfway and holding steady to the end.

summary:
[reference generation] A stranger cuts the courier gauntlet off a delivery rider's arm, leaves it on the ground, and takes the rider instead.

detailed_description:
Grimy cyberpunk street film, anamorphic, photoreal, night, dry air under a concrete deck, sodium-amber and magenta grade.

[Shot 1] Kesh holds his own gauntleted arm out straight toward Mox at chest
height and keeps it there, his own arm, extended from his own shoulder, resting
on nothing. Mox stands facing him a full arm's length away and does not touch
him: she keeps both of her own arms low and forward, well below his, and works
the lit cutter around the wrist collar of his gauntlet in one continuous
unhurried pass that takes most of the shot, white sparks pouring off his arm and
dying on the wet floor. Her own arms and hands stay bare and untouched
throughout and the blade never comes near her own body. Halfway through she
severs the armoured hose running from his gauntlet up his sleeve and it falls
loose and swings. The gauntlet is the only case anywhere in the video; the
bike's tank shell is bare brushed metal with nothing on it, and the rear pannier
stays latched shut. The camera holds low and close on both of them, Pushing in
with small amplitude at slow speed. Kesh (S1), flat, says in English: "That's
company property." Mox (S2), concentrating, says in English: "So are you."

[Shot 2] At 00:05.000, the collar parts and the whole gauntlet slides off and drops flat into the standing water, leaving his bared forearm pale and ringed with old pressure scarring where the collar sat. She leaves it lying there and swings onto the seat behind him. The camera Tracks back and out to a wider two-shot at fast speed. Kesh (S1) says in English: "You're leaving it." Mox (S2) says in English: "It's empty. Ride."

[Shot 3] At 00:09.000, the bike pulls away hard toward the bright far mouth of the underpass, the gauntlet still lying in the water in the foreground going out of focus. The camera holds still and low at ground level and lets them go from it. Both of their lips are closed from her final word to the end of the video and neither speaks again.

overall_soundscape:
Rain roars at the tunnel mouths and never falls on them, with steady dripping off the deck above. The cutter holds a thin continuous whine through the first half, sparks spitting, metal shrieking as the collar parts, and a short wet snap as the hose is cut. The gauntlet hits standing water with a flat heavy slap. The bike's motor spins up and the tyres tear grit and water as it pulls away, the sound compressing under the concrete and opening out at the far mouth. Both breathe hard and there are no words in the track beyond the four spoken lines.
